anti_overlap: Property-graph modelling, reification patterns, label/index mechanics, and loader or schema syntax — owned by the ontology reviewer; this lens owns affinity and binding, not type systems.
Correlation estimation mechanics, measurement invariance as statistical craft, and factor structure — owned by the psychometrics reviewer; this lens speaks only of concentration in a bath.
Archetype theory, sign/object/interpretant analysis, motif-index classification, and whether a symbol row is one coherent referent — owned by the semiotics reviewer.
Source independence, corroboration counting, and whether 2+ sources is a defensible evidentiary bar — owned by the transmission-criticism reviewer.
Reference-frame roles, coordinate-free reckoning, and blurred versus point placement as a navigation question — owned by the wayfinding reviewer.
Load paths, joints, differential settlement, build sequencing, and irreversibility-as-curing — owned by the masonry reviewer; cede irreversibility and raise only directionality of over-dyeing.
Copyright, paraphrase, and glossing practice — out of scope here.
decision_lens: Test affinity before value: a number scored on a substrate the axis has no binding to is worse than a missing number, because it rinses out while looking confident. State concentration per bath, never absolute counts. Ask what shares the vessel with the 546 beings and what migrates. Prefer the option needing no colour of its own — mordant or resist — over one that stores coordinates. Make every comparability claim name its illuminant, and refuse any single stability number.
distance_rationale: The six lenses already on this question are lenses on representation (ontology), estimation (psychometrics), meaning (semiotics), reference frames (etak), provenance (isnad), and force/sequence/joints (masonry). None of them is a lens on AFFINITY, CONCENTRATION, BINDING, or NEGATIVE SPACE. Pre-industrial dyeing is a millennia-refined empirical chemistry whose entire subject is what happens when you put two materials in one bath: whether the colourant has affinity for that substrate at all, what third substance must mediate the bond, how concentration is stated relative to the goods rather than absolutely, what migrates onto what else in a shared vessel, how the result degrades under each named insult, and when two things that measured identical stop matching under a different light. It shares no parent discipline with statistics, textual criticism, software architecture, mythology, navigation, or structural statics, and it is not an AI-cliche domain. It owns questions no listed option asks. (1) The universal five are dyes; beings and symbols are different fibres — the doc assumes an axis that applies to wool applies to cotton, when the dyer's first question is affinity for the substrate, not availability of the dye. (2) Depth of shade is percent-on-weight-of-fibre: the load on the covariance gate is not 952 rows, it is that symbols become roughly 63% of the population in exactly the ten universal-axis pairs where pairwise deletion lets them count — a concentration statement the doc never makes. (3) Metamerism: two entries with equal vectors read the same under the relatedness cosine and diverge under the jawnsight grammar, so 'comparable' is illuminant-dependent and must name its light. (4) Fastness is always plural and always named with its test, which reframes the doc's own 'corpus-level axes (spread, contestation, stability)' bullet from one new axis into a battery of independently-measured degradations. (5) The mordant supplies the strongest unlisted option: a substance with no colour of its own that nonetheless decides what colour appears — a symbol modelled as a transform over the being space rather than a point in it, an axis of it, or an edge between beings. (6) Resist supplies a second: in adire and shibori the figure is defined purely by where dye is prevented, so a symbol can be a mask over the 29-axis space holding no coordinates at all, which is structurally invisible to the covariance ratchet by construction.
expected_isomorphisms: Substrate affinity — protein versus cellulose fibre ↔ the doc's assumption that the five universal axes 'apply' to symbols because validateCanon forbids marking them not-applicable. Wool takes an acid dye; cotton in the same bath comes out pale and washes clean. Forbidding not-applicable is availability of the dye, not affinity of the fibre: the five will be scored on symbols because they must be, and the resulting values may have no binding to the substrate at all — a distinct failure from a wrong value, because it produces confident numbers that rinse out.

The mordant — alum, iron, tannin: colourless in itself, decisive for what colour appears (madder plus alum is red, madder plus iron is brown-purple) ↔ the unlisted Option E: a symbol as a transform over the being space rather than an entity in it. Turtle is not a point near Zaratan; Turtle is what makes Zaratan's existing Manifestation and Resilience read as they do. A mordant has no colour to store, so this option needs no vector, no node coordinates, and no seat in the covariance population — and it is exactly what the doc's 'symbols as axes rather than points' bullet gropes toward without reaching.

Resist-patterning — adire, shibori, bandhani, batik, where the figure exists only where dye was prevented ↔ a symbol defined by the regions of the 29-axis space it excludes rather than the coordinates it holds. A resist is a negative object: it carries no colour, it cannot bleed, it cannot shift a correlation, and it is fully expressible as a constraint on being vectors. This is the strongest structurally-safe answer to 'should a symbol be a node with coordinates at all' and no option A–D can express it.

Percent-on-weight-of-fibre — a dyer never says 'add 30g of madder', only '20% owf' ↔ the covariance ratchet's real exposure. Under pairwise deletion (heat-ledger f-012) symbols can only enter the ten pairs among the universal five, where 952 symbols against 546 beings is roughly 63% concentration in that specific bath while being 0% everywhere else. The doc argues volume ('would dominate the corpus'); the dyer argues concentration per bath, which is both narrower and sharper.

Cross-staining in a shared bath — a red goods bleeds onto a white one and neither is what it was ↔ admitting symbols into either the covariance population or the relatedness V. The damage is not to the symbols, which are new and expendable; it is to the 546 beings and the stamped baseline, whose established shades shift because they shared a vessel. Separate baths is the cheap remedy and no option states it as a requirement.

The living indigo vat — insoluble until reduced, yellow-green in the pot, blue only after oxidation in air, and a culture that must be fed or it dies ↔ two things at once. First, a symbol may have no readable value in isolation and take on value only on contact with a being, which argues the relation carries the signal, not the node. Second, the symbol tier is not a build but a vat: 952 entries carry an ongoing keeping cost (re-scoring as sources are added, drift against the being axes), and no option prices maintenance.

Fastness is plural and each kind names its test — lightfast but not washfast, washfast but crocks ↔ the doc's proposed corpus-level axis family (spread, contestation, stability over time). The dyer's discipline forbids a single 'stability' number: each fastness is a named insult applied under a stated procedure with its own grade. That converts a vague new axis family into a specific, buildable battery, and it applies to beings as readily as to symbols.

Metamerism — two shades that match under daylight and diverge under candlelight ↔ 'comparability' between beings and symbols on the universal five. Equality of vectors is consumer-relative: two records equal under the relatedness cosine can be wildly unequal under the jawnsight grammar's thresholds and under the 47-family clustering. Every claim that Options A or B deliver comparability must name the illuminant it holds under.

The exhaust bath and dye-lot drift — the first dip and the tenth from the same pot do not match, and nobody notices until two pieces are laid side by side ↔ promoting the symbol tier in batches under axis definitions that shift as scorers learn. The visible failure is not at promotion time but on the site, when two symbols from different lots sit adjacent in a family or a relatedness list and read as incompatible.

Scouring — unscoured fibre takes dye blotchily and the dyer blames the cloth, not the dye ↔ the 4,839 registry rows entering promotion with no preparation step named. Preparation is a separately budgeted operation in every dye house, never folded into dyeing, and no option costs it as its own stage with its own acceptance test.

Over-dyeing goes only darker — you can add a colour but never subtract one ↔ the directionality (not merely the irreversibility) of shipping symbol coordinates. Every later correction to a symbol axis can only layer over what shipped; the remedy in the dye house is to strike a small sample first and match it against the standard before committing the goods.
focus: Whether each option establishes affinity between the universal five and the symbol substrate before scoring them; the concentration each option puts into each specific bath (covariance pairs, relatedness V, clustering); what cross-stains onto the 546 beings; and whether a symbol needs to hold colour at all, or can be a mordant or a resist.
name: fd-dyer-mordant-and-resist
persona: Apply the perspective of a master dyer from a pre-industrial indigo and mordant tradition. It asks first whether a colourant has any affinity for this fibre, then what mediates the bond, then how much relative to the weight of the goods, then what else is in the bath. It knows colour can be made purely by preventing dye, that a shade matched in daylight can part under candlelight, that a vat is a living thing needing feeding, and that fastness is never one number.
review_areas: Affinity before availability: validateCanon forbidding not-applicable makes the universal five available on symbols, not binding. Test each of the five for affinity to a referent-less substrate.
Concentration per bath, not total count: state symbols as a percentage in each specific consumer — the ten universal-axis pairs, relatedness V, the 47-family clustering — not as 952 rows.
Cross-staining: name what migrates onto the 546 beings and the stamped baseline in a shared vessel. Ask whether separate baths (own gate, own baseline, own V) is a requirement, not an option.
The mordant option: develop symbol-as-transform-over-being-space — no coordinates, no node vector, decides how a being's existing axes read. Say what it stores, who owns it, and how it is checked.
The resist option: a symbol as a mask over regions of the 29-axis space, defined by what it excludes. Test whether it serves the archetypal register while holding no values the ratchet can see.
Metamerism: every comparability claim must name its illuminant. Show where two equal vectors read alike under the relatedness cosine and diverge under jawnsight or the family clustering.
Fastness is plural: convert the proposed corpus-level axis family (spread, contestation, stability) into named insults with stated tests and separate grades. Reject any single stability number.
The vat is kept, not built: price the ongoing cost of 952 symbol entries — re-scoring as sources land, drift against the being axes — and flag any option whose case rests on one-time build cost.
Scouring as its own stage: name the preparation operation on the 4,839 registry rows, its acceptance test, and its budget. Flag any option that folds preparation into promotion and calls it done.
Strike a sample first: over-dyeing only goes darker. For any option that ships coordinates, require a small matched lot against the standard before the full goods, and name what the standard is.

severity_examples.condition: When an option scores the universal five on symbols without first establishing per-axis affinity to the symbol substrate, and admits those values into any estimate shared with the 546 beings.
severity_examples.scenario: Confident numbers with no binding to the substrate: because the five universal axes can never be marked not-applicable, all ~952 symbol entries receive scored values on axes that have no affinity for a referent-less entity. The values pass validateCanon, enter the covariance population at roughly 63% concentration in the ten universal-axis pairs, and shift max |r|, the redundant-pair census, and named-cluster membership. The being corpus is cross-stained by a colourant that never bonded to anything, and the stamped baseline now encodes it as a fact about the corpus.

severity_examples.condition: When an option's comparability argument is stated over the vector itself rather than per-consumer, with no test showing agreement across the relatedness cosine, the family clustering, and the jawnsight grammar.
severity_examples.scenario: Comparability is claimed without naming its illuminant: Option A or B asserts beings and symbols are comparable on the shared five, but the claim is tested only under one consumer. Two records with near-identical universal-five vectors land in the same relatedness neighbourhood while the jawnsight grammar's thresholds derive contradictory player-visible traits from them, and the 47-family clustering assigns them to different families. The comparability guarantee holds under one light and parts under the other two, with nothing in CI able to detect it.

severity_examples.condition: When an option prices only the build and states no keeping cost — no re-scoring cadence, no lot identifier on promoted symbol entries, no drift check between symbol batches.
severity_examples.scenario: The vat is built and never fed: the symbol tier ships as a one-time promotion of 952 entries, and as new mythref sources land, symbol scores are never re-struck while being scores continue to move. Lot-to-lot drift becomes visible only on the site, where two symbols promoted in different batches sit adjacent in a family listing and read as scored by different rules — and the citation-stability rule means neither can simply be replaced.

source_domain: Pre-industrial natural dyeing and resist-patterning — Indian and West African indigo vatting (aizome, adire, bandhani), Turkey red, Japanese shibori and kasuri, Andean cochineal: substrate affinity (protein versus cellulose fibre), scouring before any dye will take, the mordant as a colourless intermediary that decides what colour a dye becomes, depth of shade stated as percent-on-weight-of-fibre rather than absolute quantity, the exhaust bath and dye-lot drift, the living indigo vat that is yellow-green in the pot and blue only after oxidation in air, plural named fastness tests (light, wash, crock, perspiration), cross-staining in a shared bath, metamerism where two shades match under one illuminant and diverge under another, and resist-patterning where the figure is made entirely by where dye is prevented.
success_hints: Lead with affinity, not with count: 'this axis has no binding to this substrate' is a stronger and more actionable finding than any argument about 952 rows.
Always convert a count into a concentration in a named bath — 63% of the ten universal-axis pairs bites harder than 952 versus 546 and points at a specific estimator.
Develop the mordant and resist options far enough to be killed or kept: what each stores, which gate owns it, and what it looks like when the transform stops holding.
Attach an illuminant to every comparability claim you evaluate — relatedness cosine, family clustering, or jawnsight grammar — and show where the match parts.
When an option survives, state its strike-a-sample plan: the small matched lot, the standard it is matched against, and who reads the match before the full goods go in.
task_context: Determine how the jawnomicon symbol tier should be structured: what vector (if any) a symbol entry carries, how symbols relate to the existing 29-axis eidogen space for beings, and where symbols sit in the graph and relatedness layers. Surface options beyond the four already listed, especially any that question whether a symbol should be a node with coordinates at all. Attack each option against the measured constraints: the five universal axes, the covariance ratchet's pairwise-deletion estimates, the hygiene-09 V-shrinkage lesson, the strict 29-key creature schema, and the downstream jawnsight grammar. Target document: docs/symbol-tier-design-question.md (jawnomicon-nhe.3).
